FN-TJ37151-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 393
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Arnold Mooney
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/22/2024
House Bill 393 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of certain consumer protections regarding publishing content
harmful to children by commercial entities, as provided by this bill; however, these obligations
may be offset by any damages or attorney's fees that are recovered from violators of the
provisions of this bill and retained by the Attorney General.
